name: JNSE HOLDOUT
description: JNSE holdout (coach M4), never used to design fixes: another sample (PS50, D = 1.2 A^2/ns at 320 K).
instruction: Use exactly the object names given. End the item by printing exactly ONE line: the result label the item gives, then only the values asked for, in the order asked, separated by spaces.
setup:
import math, os, shutil def write_dtr(path, sample, info, run, temp, D, A=0.95, qs=(0.03893043, 0.05502866, 0.07045429, 0.08793830, 0.1034360, 0.1196200), taus=(0.5005917, 2.003166, 4.006066, 6.008912, 10.01473, 20.02899, 30.04368, 40.05837, 50.07301, 60.08769, 70.10233, 80.11702)): """A J-NSE .dtr file like report19971_1.2.dtr (CR line ends, one dataset per q): S(q,t)/S(q) = A exp(-D q^2 t), err = 0.01 + 0.0002 t, q in 1/A, t in ns, D in A^2/ns.""" def e(v): # Fortran E15.7: 0.3893043E-01 if v == 0: return "0.0000000E+00".rjust(15) m, x = ("%.6E" % abs(v)).split("E") digits = m.replace(".", "") return (("-" if v < 0 else "") + "0." + digits + "E%+03d" % (int(x) + 1)).rjust(15) lines = [] for k, q in enumerate(qs): lines += ['%s "%s"' % (sample, info), "%s W fqt vs t/ns %d%02d" % (sample, run, k + 1), "", "parameter"] header = [("q", e(q)), ("q_var", e(0.0002)), ("q_unit_SI", e(1e10)), ("t_unit_SI", e(1e-9)), ("temp", e(temp)), ("numor1", "%d" % run), ("ref1", "%d" % (run - 1)), ("bgr1", "%d" % (run + 5)), ("withbgr", "1"), ("tfac_bgr", e(0.9)), ("volfrac", e(1.0)), ("qbins", "%d" % len(qs)), ("tbins", "%d" % len(taus)), ("oor_cnt", "226"), ("upd_cnt", "3760")] lines += ["%-10s %s" % (key, value.strip() if "E" in value else value.rjust(8)) for key, value in header] lines += ["", "values", " tau/ns S(q,t)/S(q) err(sqt/sq) var(sqt/sq) var(tau)/ns nupdates Qeff/A**-1 "] for t in taus: s = A * math.exp(-D * q * q * t) lines.append(" %s%s%s%s%s%10d%s" % (e(t), e(s), e(0.01 + 0.0002 * t), e(0.1), e(0.0), 36, e(q))) lines += ["", "#nxt"] with open(os.path.expanduser(path), "w", newline="") as f: f.write(" ".join(lines) + " ") base = os.path.expanduser("~/benchdata/jnse") shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True) os.makedirs(base) write_dtr(os.path.join(base, 'report95001_2.5.dtr'), 'PS50', 'PS 50k in d toluene', 95001, 320.0, 1.2) # the NSE fit function of qtisas.com/jnse, compiled when the library does not have it if 'simpleDiffusion' not in Fittable.fitFunctions(): c = Compiler open(os.path.join(c.path, 'simpleDiffusion.fif'), 'w').write('[group] [Weight] 1 [Algorithm] 1 NSE [name] simpleDiffusion [number parameters] 4, [description]

simpleDiffusion:

Intermediate scattering function for diffusing particles.

.. math:: I(q,t)=Ae^{-q^2 (Dt + 0.5w^2t^2)}

[x] t [y] Iqt [parameter names] q,A,D,w, [initial values] 1[0..inf],1[0..inf],0[0..inf],0[0..inf] [adjustibility] 0,1,1,0 [parameter description] Wavevector,Prefactor,Diffusion coefficient in units [ [q]**-2/[t] ],Width of diffusion coefficient distribution in D units., [h-headers] [included functions] [code] // ---> Iqt = f ( t, {P1, ...} ); Iqt= A*exp(-pow(q,2.0)*(D*t+0.5*fabs(w)*w*t*t)); [fortran] 0, [end]') c.scanGroups() c.open('simpleDiffusion') c.compile()

items.text: Read the NSE measurement report95001_2.5.dtr from benchdata/jnse in the home directory into a header table named psInfo. Print the number of q values and the smallest q, rounded to 4 decimals.
Fit all q of psInfo together with simpleDiffusion, A and D shared, w fixed at 0. Print D rounded to 2 decimals.
With that D, print the relaxation rate D q^2 at the largest q of psInfo in 1/ns, rounded to 4 decimals.
Print S(q,t)/S(q) at the last Fourier time of the smallest q of psInfo, rounded to 4 decimals.
